children.name: example
children.value:
To solve

\begin{equation}
e^{-x^2} - x = 0
\end{equation}

First rearrange

\begin{align}
x = e^{-x^2} = g(x)
\end{align}

Then, guess $x_0 = 0$ and set up a table:

| $n$ | $x_n$ | $g(x_n)$ |
|-----|-------|----------|
| 0   | 0     | 1.000    |
| 1   | 1.000 | 0.368    |
| 2   | 0.368 | 0.873    |
| ... | ...   | ...      |
| 51  | 0.653 | 0.6528   |

At each iteration, $g(x_n)$ is used as the new $x_n$ until at $n = 5$, where
$x_n = 0.6530 \approx 0.6528 = g(x_n)$.

children.name: example
children.value:
Solve $x^2 = 2$.

---

We can rewrite this as $f(x) = x^2-2 = 0$. We will also evaluate the derivative
$f'(x) = 2x$. Let the initial guess be $x_0 = 1$.

| $n$ | $x_n$ | $f(x_n)$              | $f'(x_n)$ |
|-----|-------|-----------------------|-----------|
| 0   | 1.0   | -1.0                  |  2.0      |
| 1   | 1.5   | 0.25                  |  3.0      |
| 2   | 1.417 | $6.94 \times 10^{-3}$ |  2.833    |
| 3   | 1.414 |                       |           |

This is close to the known value of $\sqrt{2}$!
